name: redis-key-audit
description: Redis Key 空间审计 CLI 工具

scripts.test:clean: node bin/redis-key-audit.js -i data/clean-sample.json -o test-output --format json > /dev/null && echo 'Clean sample test passed'
scripts.test:dirty: node bin/redis-key-audit.js -i data/invalid-ttl-sample.json -o test-output --format json 2>&1 || echo 'Dirty sample correctly rejected (exit code '$?')'
